diagnosis: Customer's client is not honoring the Retry-After header on 429 responses. Guidance is covered by kb-0014: use the header value with jitter; sustained 429s indicate the plan ceiling.
reply: When you receive a 429, the response includes a Retry-After header with the number of seconds to wait before retrying. Your client should read that header and wait at least that long, adding some jitter (a small random offset) so retries don't all land at the same moment. If you see 429s continuously across an entire window rather than in bursts, that usually indicates you've reached your plan's rate ceiling rather than a temporary spike. If you'd like, share the request pattern you're seeing and we can take a closer look.
